limitations: A 6-bit counter cannot detect a loss of a multiple of 64 samples.
Counter disagreement alone does not identify which ADC values, if any, are corrupt.
Dominant-phase residual excludes the first 1000 samples so a startup phase change does not incorrectly flag the entire record.
